summary_1line: Arjuna urges Yudhishthira to rule and support society through charity, while Yudhishthira replies that true renunciation and knowledge surpass mere action.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna stands before the sorrowful Yudhishthira in the royal hall, passionately urging him not to abandon the throne for a mendicant’s life.
A wandering ascetic with a triple-headed staff and earthen bowl walks away from a palace while citizens look on anxiously.
Yudhishthira calmly replies to Arjuna, surrounded by scriptures and sages, speaking of renunciation and knowledge of Brahman.
